description: University of Ljubljana publishes an Excel cost-benefit model for proposed cycling highways in Ljubljana. The Zenodo README distinguishes MIT-licensed workbook formulas from CC BY 4.0 input data. Separate workbooks estimate mode choice, construction and land acquisition costs; CBA.xlsx calculates discounted benefits, net present value and internal rate of return over a default thirty-year horizon. Version 2.0.0 adds an infrastructure scenario and wider sensitivity tests. These files can compare cycling-investment assumptions in transport-planning simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workbook model. Coverage is the proposed Ljubljana corridors and stated assumptions, not observed post-construction effects. Detailed construction work items are confidential and excluded. Forecast uptake and monetised health or emissions benefits remain uncertain. The manuscript was revised and submitted after peer review; acceptance is not established. No workbook was downloaded or formula recalculated.
name: Cost–Benefit Analysis of Cycling Infrastructure in Ljubljana
